summary: A young man walks along a park pathway on a sunny autumn day, holding his phone in front of him to capture a walking selfie vlog shot.

people.description: Young East Asian man with fluffy dark hair, wearing a black tailored overcoat over a grey crewneck sweater, carrying a backpack.

quality.issues: Slight camera shake and occasional vertical angle dip at the start and end of clip.

moments.action: Creator walks forward holding phone at arm's length, glancing between the camera and surroundings with sunlight filtering through yellowing park trees.
Creator turns profile slightly to look off to the side while continuing to walk beneath golden tree foliage.
Creator looks directly forward into the camera lens while walking briskly through the sunlit park.
